name: AI-Powered Agent Assist
description: Tools that support live agents during calls, including transcription, sentiment analysis, and knowledge base suggestions.
rationale: Shifted from generic 'tools' to emphasize 'AI', reflecting current market demand and Twilio's Voice Intelligence capabilities.

name: Intelligent IVR
description: Automated phone menus that let callers self-route or solve routine tasks.
rationale: Retained original name; highly recognized industry standard.

name: Intelligent Routing
description: Tools that dynamically route inbound call requests to the most qualified agent.
rationale: Retained original name; core capability of TaskRouter.

name: Self-Service Automation
description: Allow users to handle simple actions via automated channels without agent help.
rationale: Retained original name; effectively captures the deflection value prop.

name: Chatbots & Virtual Assistants
description: Automated conversational tools answering questions or guiding users without human agents.
rationale: Added dual-category tag as this bridges support deflection and marketing engagement.

name: Call Tracking & Analytics
description: Track inbound calls dynamically to attribute them to specific campaigns or analyze call quality.
rationale: Expanded to include 'Analytics' to highlight the data value beyond just number provisioning.

name: Omnichannel 2-Way Communication
description: Enable bidirectional conversational messaging between customers and agents via SMS, WhatsApp, or Chat.
rationale: Standardized terminology to 'Omnichannel' which resonates better with enterprise buyers.

name: Omnichannel Support Chat
description: Provide real-time, text-based support across web chat, SMS, and messaging apps.
rationale: Added 'Omnichannel' to specify multi-platform capability.

name: Appointment Scheduling & Reminders
description: Automated confirmations and reminders for upcoming appointments or reservations.
rationale: Added 'Reminders' to fully capture the lifecycle of the appointment.

name: Service Updates & Outage Alerts
description: Informing customers proactively of service maintenance, system outages, or schedule changes.
rationale: Added 'Outage' to highlight a high-value, critical use case for deflection.

name: Omnichannel Preference Management
description: Allow customers to easily manage which channels and topics they wish to be contacted about.
rationale: Aligned with Segment and cross-channel privacy architectures.

name: Automated Surveys & NPS
description: Automatically trigger customer satisfaction or NPS surveys immediately following an interaction.
rationale: Added 'Automated' to emphasize the programmatic nature of Twilio.

name: Transaction & Order Notifications
description: Real-time updates on order confirmations, shipping statuses, and delivery tracking.
rationale: Spelled out acronyms for clarity.

name: Personalized Discounts & Offers
description: Deliver individualized deals based on user lifecycle, interests, or past purchases.
rationale: Broadened to include 'Offers' to cover non-discount promotions.

name: Outbound Sales Campaigns
description: Proactively contacts potential customers for sales-related purposes via voice or text.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: Event Promotions & Invites
description: Automated communications to drive attendance and engagement for physical or virtual events.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: High Propensity Audience Targeting
description: Build and sync high-value audiences to advertising platforms to optimize ad spend.
rationale: Shortened for clarity; aligns directly with Segment Personas.

name: Ad Spend Optimization
description: Suppress existing customers from acquisition ads or target lookalikes of high-LTV users.
rationale: Translated generic 'optimization' into a specific financial action (Spend).

name: Click-to-Call Functionality
description: Embed voice calling directly into web or mobile apps to instantly connect prospects to sales.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: Speed to Lead Routing
description: Engage new potential customers immediately upon interest to accelerate response times.
rationale: Added 'Routing' to emphasize the architectural action.

name: Conversational Inbound Sales
description: Nurture incoming leads via interactive dialogues and routing to guide sales prospects.
rationale: Cleaned up naming convention for better presentation.

name: Inbound Communications Routing
description: Manage and route incoming customer inquiries across channels to the appropriate teams.
rationale: Added 'Routing' to specify the actual action being taken.

name: Automated Lifecycle Nurture Campaigns
description: Marketing campaigns that touch every part of the customer's journey with the right message.
rationale: Added 'Automated' to highlight the 'build it once' value of Journey Builder.

name: Cross-Channel Abandoned Cart Recovery
description: Strategies to prompt customers to complete pending online purchases across email and SMS.
rationale: Shifted from a problem ('Tackling') to a solution ('Cross-Channel Recovery').

name: Tailored Product Recommendations
description: Personalized product suggestions based on unified user data or preferences.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: Nurture & Drip Campaigns
description: Sequential, automated messages designed to educate and convert prospects over time.
rationale: Simplified name for brevity.

name: Upsell & Cross-Sell Campaigns
description: Targeted campaigns offering complementary products or premium tier upgrades.
rationale: Added 'Campaigns' for clarity.

name: Churn Mitigation & Winback
description: Identify at-risk customers and trigger automated campaigns to retain or win them back.
rationale: Reordered for standard industry phrasing.

name: Customer Loyalty & Rewards
description: Manage and communicate loyalty points, tier statuses, and exclusive reward offers.
rationale: Added 'Rewards' to cover the operational execution of loyalty programs.

name: Targeted Push Notifications
description: In-app alerts designed to pull users back into the digital product experience.
rationale: Added 'Targeted' to emphasize the Segment integration value.

name: Automated Billing & Payment Reminders
description: Reminders for upcoming payments, billing cycles, or missed payment due dates.
rationale: Added 'Automated' to emphasize programmatic execution.

name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
description: Secure login protection utilizing 2FA/OTP via SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, or Email.
rationale: Updated to standard enterprise identity terminology (MFA).

name: Account & Identity Management
description: Tools and processes for securely managing user identities, credentials, and access.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: Secure Audience Segmentation
description: Segmenting users while strictly adhering to privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and data masking.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: Security & Account Alerts
description: Real-time notifications for suspicious account activity, password changes, or new logins.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: Secure Masked Communication
description: Allow two parties (e.g., driver/rider) to communicate without exposing real phone numbers.
rationale: Added 'Masked' to clarify the specific technical use case (Proxy).

name: Identity Intelligence & Analytics
description: Analyzing identity data patterns to improve customer profiles and platform security.
rationale: Added 'Identity' context to avoid confusion with Flex analytics.

name: Fraud Detection & Mitigation
description: Utilize carrier data (SIM swap, line type) to block fraudulent signups and transactions.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: Verified Branded Calling & SMS
description: Increase answer rates by displaying verified brand names and logos on outbound communications.
rationale: Made more specific to highlight the 'Verified' trust aspect.

name: Service Consent & Opt-In
description: Secure and document verifiable consent before initiating automated marketing communications.
rationale: Added 'Opt-In' to clarify the regulatory action.

name: Employee/Workforce Shift Alerts
description: Notify employees, contractors, or sales teams of important updates or schedule changes.
rationale: Added 'Shift' to ground it in a specific, common operational reality.

name: Distributed Contact Center Enablement
description: Enable distributed customer-service teams to work seamlessly from anywhere.
rationale: Replaced 'Remote Agents' with enterprise infrastructure terminology.

name: Complete Identity Resolution
description: Merge fragmented customer data points across platforms into a single, unified Golden Record.
rationale: Retained original name.

name: Accelerated Onboarding
description: Speed customers through initial setup by combining identity verification with contextual flows.
rationale: Adjusted to standard noun phrasing.

name: Emergency Broadcasts & Notifications
description: Rapidly communicate urgent safety protocols, weather alerts, or critical event information.
rationale: Standardized naming.
